subject: reasoning
question: In a certain code language, CLOUD is written as DMNTE, and MANGO is written as NZOHN. How will PASTEUR be written in that language?
solution: [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2d16e50abe1a866069dc7ff61c99f97f83c1c43a73bc7da4d0c011f370fc1dfe.png] The logic followed here is :- The alphabetic positional value of consonant is added with +1. The alphabetic positional value of vowel is subtracted with -1. CLOUD is written as DMNTE.
tags: Coding and Decoding By Letter Shifting
